name: Chef Marco Bellini
look: a short, round, jolly chef with rosy cheeks, a huge curly black moustache and thick eyebrows; a very tall white chef hat, a white double-breasted chef jacket, a red neckerchief and a red-and-white checked apron, holding a wooden spoon
personality: Loud and dramatic, takes everything personally, always near food.
catchphrase: Mamma mia, I was in my kitchen!
